method: All 509 actual native parts, every face fan triangle, exact -X ray. Complete-scene intersections retained, no visual mesh exclusions. Native cage only; Cycles-applied bevel tessellation not evaluated.
entry_definition: Original black-opening FRONT polygon, 0.70px edge margin, 0.50px raster. Entry X is the fitted source-side surface +12mm; well rear mouth is entry-72mm. Grille-gap rays exclude any sample intersecting an actual louver ahead of the entry.
limitation: Geometric source cage check only. Candidate duct walls are distinguished by actual part names and construction, not proven airflow. A rear chamber wall is a legitimate geometric turn surface, not an open axial exhaust. Side outlet continuity and heat transfer are not evaluated.
reference_sampling_scope: Registered landmarks include left_vent_black_opening only; full right 0.5px grid mirrors that approved left outline about u325.5, consistent with model symmetry, and is not an independently traced original-right contour. Independent actual-JPG gap-point controls are separately listed.

left.method: Independent points visibly inside each actual JPG dark opening; integer pixels with max RGB <55, chosen near 3 core columns at 6 gap heights. These are diagnostic samples, not a newly approved contour.

right.method: Independent points visibly inside each actual JPG dark opening; integer pixels with max RGB <55, chosen near 3 core columns at 6 gap heights. These are diagnostic samples, not a newly approved contour.

source_figure_color_threshold_role: Used only to choose black gap points on the supplied JPG; geometry classification and hits use actual meshes, never raster colors.
reference_outline_limitation: Actual right JPG dark mouth differs from the left-mirrored model footprint. Right source control (379,204) is outside current fitted black mouth, hits gold trim first, and then front wrap at 25.75-31.76mm in the 535-part revision. This is a reference/model contour mismatch, not evidence of armor obstruction inside the current defined mouth.
